correctness.rationale: A complete triangle/four-set overlap enumeration yields the exact covariance. Independent centered Bernoulli edge orthogonality plus four-vertex Parseval gives both exact variances, with all nonstandard local coefficients computed explicitly. The executable verifies 45 exact or diagnostic assertions and exhaustively enumerates all graphs through n=6; enumeration is not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural pair of network motifs exhibits a complete covariance sign transition and an n^(-1/2) critical correlation profile with nontrivial constant 10/27. The motif first-edge projection vanishes at p=2/3, changing induced-count variance from n^6 to n^5. Distinguishing the O(n^(-1)) finite covariance-root shift from the wider O(n^(-1/2)) correlation crossover is a structural, motivated result not merely a single tabulated moment.
